Button group (attached buttons) from buttons [{ label, value, icon?: 'IconBolt', disabled?, variant? }] (label '' with an icon = icon-only). mode: 'actions' (each click fires onClick, exposed lastClicked), 'single' or 'multiple' (a segmented selection: exposed value, selected; onChange). Height 36px (sm 32px, lg 40px); add 22px for a label

Inline month calendar. mode single, multiple or range; defaultValue 'YYYY-MM-DD' (a list for multiple, [start, end] for range); markers [{ date, label?, color? }] draw dots under days (label on hover); minDate, maxDate, disabledDates, disabledDays ([0, 6] = weekends). Exposed value, selectedDate, selectedDates, startDate, endDate, visibleMonth ('YYYY-MM'), visibleStart, visibleEnd; events onSelect, onMonthChanged. One month is about 300px tall and 250px wide (fullWidth stretches the days)

Grid of cards from data, for things with a face (recipes, products, listings, people, rooms, projects): each card shows an image when imageField is mapped (a row without a picture gets a tinted panel with the title's initials; no imageField, no picture area), an eyebrow (eyebrowField: a small caps line above the title, such as a category or a code), an avatar beside the title (avatarField: an image URL, else the initials of that field's text; for people and owners), title, subtitle, badges (badgeField, plus badgeFields for more: 'cuisine, diet', at most 4; each toned by its words: Available green, Low stock amber, Sold out red), a description (two lines), a progress bar (progressField: a percentage 0 to 100, as 42 or '42%') and a meta line (metaFields, a comma list; 'prep:{} min' puts the value in a label, 'serves:Serves' puts the label first). layout 'stacked' (image on top) or 'row' (image left, text right: listings, people, a compact catalogue). columns (a number, or 'auto' to fit cards of minCardWidth), imageAspect ('16/9', '4/3', '1/1'; stacked only), cardStyle 'elevated', 'outline' or 'flat'. A click selects the card (selectedItem, selectedItemId, selectedItemIndex; onCardClicked). Height: grows with its rows (about 300px per row stacked with an image, 150px without or in rows)

Carousel of slides [{ image, title?, description?, link? }] (or image URLs) with arrows and dots, loop, autoplay (interval ms, pauses on hover), slidesPerView 1 to 4, aspectRatio ('16/9', '4/3', '1/1', '21/9' or 'fill' to fill the widget's height), imageFit cover or contain, captions as an overlay or below. Exposed currentIndex, currentSlide and clickedSlide (with its index); events onSlideChanged, onSlideClicked (a slide's link also opens in a new tab); actions next, previous, goTo(index). Height follows the width and ratio (+28px for dots, +52px for captions below)

ToolJet UI 2.0 chat: the native Chat widget's properties, events, exposed values and actions in the pack's look. Message rows with an avatar (an image URL, else initials) and the sender's name; the user's turns sit on the right in an accent bubble, replies on the left with markdown (lists, tables, code). A new user turn moves near the top of the view and the reply grows below it; scrolled up, the view stays where the reader is and a Jump to latest button appears. loadingResponse shows a typing indicator, loadingHistory skeleton rows. A message is { message, type: 'message' (user) | 'response' | 'error', name, avatar, timestamp, messageId }. Wire onMessageSent to a query that reads components.<chat>.lastMessage.message and appends its answer with the appendHistory action ({ message, type: 'response' }), with setResponseLoading around it. Height: fixed (the messages scroll); give it 400 to 700px
Checkbox with label

Circular progress ring: value 0 to 100 (clamped), size and thickness (px), lineCap ('round', 'flat'), centerText ('value' shows 63%, 'custom' shows text, 'none') with an optional label under it; barColor (default: the primary), trackColor, textColor, labelColor styles. Height: the size (96px by default)

Color picker: a swatch-and-hex field opening a popover with a saturation/hue picker, a hex input and preset swatches (array of hex). Exposes value (#rrggbb, or #rrggbbaa with allowAlpha), selectedColorRGB and selectedColorRGBA. Height: 64px with a label, 36px without

Combobox: a searchable single select (popover with a search box). options: plain values or [{ label, value, description?, icon? (Tabler name like IconUser, image URL or emoji), group?, disabled? }]; exposes value, selectedOption, searchText. Height: 64px with a label, 36px without; add 24px for help text

Bar and line chart on one axis pair: data [{ month: 'Jan', revenue: 42000, margin: 31 }], xField 'month', barFields 'revenue' (bars), lineFields 'margin' (lines), rightAxisFields 'margin' (those series on a second, right axis with its own rightAxisFormat, e.g. percent); stackBars, curve, dots, yAxisFormat number/currency/percent/compact. Height 240-340 px; clicking sets clickedDataPoint and fires onClick.

Currency amount input: the currency sign inside the box, the amount formatted for the locale with Intl (1,250.00 in en-US, 1.250,00 in de-DE). Exposes value (a number, null when empty), formattedValue ('$1,250.00') and currency ('USD'). currency is an ISO code; currencyOptions (['USD', 'EUR', 'GBP']) adds a currency picker at the start of the box; decimalPlaces empty uses the currency's own (JPY 0). Height: 64px with a label (label above the control), 36px without; add 24px for help text or a validation message
Date picker (popover calendar), single date or range. Height: 64px with a label (label above the control), 36px without; add 24px for help text

Date and time picker: a field opening a calendar with a time row (hour, minute, AM/PM; a time every minuteStep minutes from midnight). Exposes value as 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm' (local time, '' when empty), selectedDate 'YYYY-MM-DD', selectedTime 'HH:mm', unixTimestamp (ms) and displayValue (dateFormat plus the time). defaultValue takes ISO text, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm' or a unix timestamp; minDate/maxDate ('YYYY-MM-DD') and disabledDates (array) block days. Height: 64px with a label (label above the control), 36px without; add 24px for help text or a validation message

Dialog or side sheet (ToolJet Modal in the pack look): header, body and footer canvases (put a ShadHeading and a muted ShadText in the header, the form in the body, ShadButtons in the footer); open and close it with the show-modal / close-modal event actions or its open and close actions; exposed show. Kind "sheet" slides in from the side at full height

Dropdown menu: a trigger button (label + variant, or an icon-only '...' trigger) opening a menu of items [{ label, value, icon?: 'IconPencil', description?, shortcut?: '⌘E', disabled?, visible?, destructive?, separator? (line above), group? (heading) }]. On select fires onSelect with lastClickedOption { label, value, description }. Height 36px (sm 32px, lg 40px)
Empty state with title, description and an optional action

File upload: a dashed dropzone (drag and drop or click to browse) with a file list. accept is a MIME or extension list like 'image/*,.pdf'; maxSize and minSize in bytes. Exposes file [{ name, type, size, content (text), base64Data, dataURL, parsedData, parseError }] like the native File picker, with parseError naming why parsing failed ('' when it did not). Height: about 160px for the dropzone, 180px with a label; the list adds about 66px per file (dynamic height)

Funnel of stages in order: data [{ stage: 'Visited', count: 12480 }, { stage: 'Paid', count: 412 }], stageField 'stage', valueField 'count'; one bar per stage sized to the widest, its value, and its conversion % from the stage before (conversionBase 'previous') or from the first ('first'); align center/left, colorByStage (palette per stage, else one colour fading down), yAxisFormat for values. About 44 px per stage; clicking a stage sets clickedDataPoint to its row and fires onClick.

Heading (h1 to h4). Typeface styles: fontFamily ('theme', 'sans', 'serif', 'display' or 'mono'), fontWeight (400 to 800), fontSize (px), letterSpacing (px or em) and textTransform ('uppercase' for an eyebrow)

Heatmap: a grid of cells shaded by value, for two categories against each other (weekday by hour, region by month). data [{ day: 'Mon', hour: '09:00', tickets: 12 }], yField 'day' (rows), xField 'hour' (columns), valueField 'tickets' (rows landing in the same cell are summed); xOrder / yOrder fix the order (else first appearance); showValues prints each value; a min-to-max legend. Height about 32 px per row plus 40; clicking a cell sets clickedDataPoint and fires onClick.

Page hero at the top of a page: eyebrow (small caps line above), title, subtitle, meta facts (['Sun, 11 Oct', '14 bookings'] or [{ label, value }]), an aside on the right and up to two actions (actionLabel, secondaryActionLabel; onActionClicked, onSecondaryActionClicked). The aside is one headline figure (asideValue 12480 or '$12,480', asideLabel 'Revenue today' above it) or a short list of facts (asideValue [{ label: 'Open', value: 14 }, { label: 'Due today', value: 3 }], up to 4, asideLabel as their heading). Greetings and header facts belong in the hero itself: 'Good morning, Ada' as the title, one line of what needs attention as the subtitle, today's date and counts as meta chips, the one number that matters in the aside; never a separate Text or Stat floating beside or over the header. With an aside, the actions sit under the text. background 'plain' (no panel), 'tint' (a soft panel in the accent), 'gradient' (accent wash), 'image' (imageUrl behind a dark overlay, white text) or 'dark' (deep accent panel, white text); icon (lucide name) in a rounded tile beside the title; align left or center (the aside goes under the text); size compact, default or large. Styles accentColor (else the theme's primary), titleFontFamily ('serif', 'display', ...). Height: grows with its content (about 150px default, 120px compact, 220px large; add 40px for actions under the text)

Icon: icon is any lucide name ('trending-up' or 'TrendingUp'; unknown names show a neutral dashed circle), size (px), strokeWidth, tone (default, muted, primary, success, warning, destructive) or the iconColor style, chip ('none', 'circle', 'square') for the tinted icon chip of KPI cards (chipColor style, else a tint of the icon colour; chipSize, else size x 2); onClick. Height: 40px with a chip at size 20, else the icon size

Image: source (URL), alternativeText, imageFit (cover, contain, fill), aspectRatio ('auto' fills the drawn height; '16/9', '4/3', '1/1' size it from the width), caption below, fallback when the URL is empty or fails ('placeholder', 'icon', or 'initials' of fallbackText), showBorder, zoomOnClick lightbox; a skeleton shows while it loads; onClick. Height: as drawn with aspect auto (a caption takes 28px of it)
Text input with label. Height: 64px with a label (label above the control), 36px without; add 24px for help text

Kanban board from data: columns are values of a status field; cards show the fields you map (title, description, badge, tags, progress, meta, avatar), or, with Card content Custom, child components laid out on the card and bound to {{cardData.<field>}}. Drag to move, optional add and delete buttons, and addCard/updateCardData/deleteCard/moveCard actions; save changes with queries on the card events (components.<name>.lastCardMovement, lastAddedCard, lastRemovedCard, lastUpdatedCard, updatedCardData). lastCardMovement is {cardId, card, from, to, toIndex}: a move saves with lastCardMovement.cardId and .to (the native names cardDetails, originColumnId, destinationColumnId, originCardIndex and destinationIndex also work)

Description list for a record's details: data is an object ({ Status: 'Active', Owner: 'Ada' }) or an array of { label, value, type?, format? } with type text, number, currency, date, badge, link or boolean (format: a date format or { currency, decimalPlaces, prefix, suffix }); columns 1 to 4; layout 'inline' (label beside the value, labelWidth) or 'stacked'; dividers; emptyText for blanks; currency, dateFormat and badgeColors defaults; allowCopy. Height: about 41px per row inline, 69px stacked (per column when columns > 1)

Line chart for trends: data [{ month: 'Jan', revenue: 18600, expenses: 8000 }], xField 'month', yFields 'revenue,expenses' (one line each); curve monotone/linear/step, dots, strokeWidth, dashedFields, an optional target line (referenceValue, referenceLabel) and yAxisFormat number/currency/percent/compact. Height 200-320 px; clicking a point sets clickedDataPoint and fires onClick.

Text link (native Link names): linkText, linkTarget (URL; empty makes it act as a button), targetType ('new' or 'same' tab), underline ('underline', 'on-hover', 'no-underline'), showIcon (external-link icon), fontSize (px), fontWeight (normal, medium, semibold, bold); textColor and hoverColor styles (default: the primary). onClick fires as well as navigating; onHover. Height: 24px at 14px

List or grid: one canvas repeated per item of data; parent components to it and bind them to {{listItem.<field>}}. A click selects the item (selectedItem, selectedRecord; onRecordClicked); optional pagination (client or server side), dividers, hover and selected highlight. Items have a fixed height (rowHeight)

Map with markers from rows, on open map tiles (no API key): delivery stops and routes, field jobs and service zones, stores, sites, listings, incidents. data: rows read through latField and lngField (numbers or numeric text; rows without valid coordinates, or at exactly 0, 0, are skipped and counted in a footnote), titleField, subtitleField (a second line: the address), statusField and idField. Pins are coloured by status: by its words (Delivered or Done green, Delayed or Pending amber, Failed or Overdue red, Open, Scheduled or In transit blue; or a tone name success | warning | danger | info), or by statusColors ({ 'Under offer': '#d97706', Open: 'warning' }); showLegend (on) lists the colours with counts. labelField puts a short value in the pin (a stop number) or, longer, a price pill ('€450k'); iconField puts a lucide icon in the pin ('snowflake', 'droplets', 'zap'); markerIcon sets one icon for every pin (iconField wins per row). headingField (degrees, 0 north, clockwise) turns the icon or image to where a vehicle is going, best with 'navigation' or 'plane'. imageField shows an image per row (an https URL, a path or a data URI, SVG included; it should point north for heading) instead of the pin, with a ring of its status colour; a broken or unsafe URL keeps the pin. markerSize: small, medium (default) or large. Routes: connectMarkers draws a line through the markers in routeOrderField order, one per routeField value (a driver, a van), from routeStart (a depot { lat, lng }) when given; routes (a second dataset) draws lines from rows { name, path: [[lat, lng], ...] or a GeoJSON LineString, color or status }; routeColors names each line's colour. Areas (zones, territories, geofences): areas rows with an outline (areaShapeField: [[lat, lng], ...], a GeoJSON Polygon or its JSON text) or a circle (lat, lng and areaRadiusField in metres), titled by areaTitleField and filled by areaStatusField's tone (or the row's color). A click on a marker selects it (selectedMarker: its row, selectedMarkerId), opens a popup with the title, status and popupFields (a comma list of field specs as the Record list's metaFields: 'driver', 'eta:ETA {}', 'total|currency'; showPopup off for none) and fires onMarkerClick; a click on a line or area exposes selectedShape (its row) and selectedShapeType ('route' | 'area') and fires onShapeClicked; a click on the map clears the selection, exposes clickedLocation { lat, lng } and fires onMapClicked. pickLocation lets the user click (or drag a pin) to choose a spot: pickedLocation { lat, lng, address } and onLocationPicked (defaultPickedLocation starts it); showSearch adds an address search box (OpenStreetMap Nominatim by default, rate-limited; geocoderUrl and reverseGeocoderUrl, with {query} or {lat} and {lng}, point it at another geocoder). display 'heat' (or 'both') draws density instead of pins, weighted by heatField. clusterMarkers groups crowded pins into counts (on by default; keeps thousands of rows smooth). fitToMarkers (on by default) opens on everything drawn and refits when data changes; off, the map opens on defaultCenter ({ lat, lng }, [lat, lng] or 'lat, lng') at defaultZoom (1 to 18; 12 is a city, 15 a street). scrollWheelZoom is off by default (the page scrolls past the map; Ctrl or Cmd with the wheel zooms); showFullscreen adds a fullscreen button; mapStyle 'satellite' shows imagery and showStyleSwitch a Map | Satellite toggle. Exposes center, zoom and bounds after every move; onBoundsChange fires when the user pans or zooms. Actions: setCenter(lat, lng, zoom), setZoom, fitBounds, selectMarker(id), clearSelection, setPickedLocation(lat, lng), clearPickedLocation, setMapStyle('streets' | 'satellite'). Height: fixed (the map fills it); give it 320 to 640px

Multi-select combobox: picked options show as removable chips in the field (+N past maxVisibleChips), with search and select all. options like the Combobox; defaultValue is an array of values; exposes values (array) and selectedOptions. Height: 64px with a label, 36px without (one row of chips; grows with dynamic height)

App navigation: a vertical sidebar list or a horizontal top bar from items [{ label, value, icon?: 'IconHome', badge?, disabled?, group? (sidebar heading), children?: [{ label, value }] }] (children open as a dropdown in the top bar, a nested list in the sidebar). variant pills, underline or ghost; defaultValue is the active item; onClick fires on click with exposed value and selectedItem { label, value, parentLabel, parentValue } (wire page switches here); selectItem(value). Item height 36px; a top bar is 40px tall, a sidebar fills the widget's height

Number input: value is a number (null when empty), rounded to decimalPlaces (0 to 10); step buttons (stepper: split -/+ at both ends, stacked arrows at the right, or none) and ArrowUp/ArrowDown move by step and stop at the Min/Max value validation; optional prefix/suffix text inside the box (e.g. '$', 'kg') and thousands separators. Height: 64px with a label (label above the control), 36px without; add 24px for help text or a validation message

One-time code input: length (4 to 8) character boxes, numeric or alphanumeric (upper-cased), typing moves to the next box, Backspace goes back, pasting a whole code fills it ('123-456' works). Optional separator in the middle and masked dots. Exposes value and isComplete; onComplete fires when the last box is filled (verify there). Boxes are 36px (slotSize style); height 64px with a label, 36px without

Pagination (native Pagination names): numberOfPages, or totalRecords with pageSize; defaultPageIndex (1-based); Previous / page numbers with ellipsis / Next (showLabels), optional first and last buttons (showFirstLast), siblingCount, size 'sm' or 'default'. onPageChange; action setPage(page); exposed currentPageIndex (1-based) and totalPages. Bind a query offset to (currentPageIndex - 1) * pageSize. Height: 36px (32px small)

Password input with a show/hide eye button (showToggle) and an optional strength meter (showStrength: a three-part weak/fair/strong bar under the box, exposed as strength = '' | 'weak' | 'fair' | 'strong'). Validate with the text rules (mandatory, regex, min length). Height: 64px with a label (label above the control), 36px without; add 24px for help text or a validation message; the strength meter adds 16px

Phone number input: a country picker (flag and calling code; searchable list) attached to the number box, which formats as you type. Exposes value (E.164, e.g. '+14155550123', '' when empty), country ('US'), countryCode ('+1'), formattedValue ('+1 415 555 0123') and isValidNumber; isValid is false for an invalid number. defaultCountry is an ISO code; onlyCountries limits the list (['US', 'CA']). Height: 64px with a label (label above the control), 36px without; add 24px for help text or a validation message
Pie or donut chart with an optional center figure
Progress bar with optional label

List of progress rows from data, for goals, budgets, quotas, onboarding steps and capacity: each row has a label (labelField), its value against a target ('$18,400 of $25,000': valueField, targetField, in valueFormat: auto, number, currency in currency, percent, compact), a progress bar, an optional status (statusField: a chip toned by its words, On track green, At risk amber, Over budget or Behind red; a status that only names a tone, success, warning, danger, info or neutral, colours the bar without a chip) and an optional trailing caption under the bar ('12 days left': captionField). The percentage is percentField when the data has one (0 to 100), else value / target; a row with a value and no target reads the value as the percentage. autoTone colours bars from their percentage when the row has no status: 'goal' green at 100%, 'limit' (budgets, quotas, storage) amber from 80% and red over 100%. showValues and showPercent pick the figures shown; barSize thin, default or thick; listStyle 'card' (bordered panel) or 'plain'. A click on a row exposes selectedItem and selectedItemId and fires onItemClicked (rows look clickable only when it is handled). Use a Stat or a Summary strip for one headline figure, a Progress for a single bar. Height: grows with its rows (about 64px a row, 76px with captions)

ToolJet UI 2.0 multi-step questionnaire, one question at a time: a 'Question 2 of 5' progress bar, the prompt and description, answer cards with a letter (or number) shortcut, and Previous, Skip (optional questions), Next and Submit. items: [{ name, prompt, description, required, type: 'single' | 'multiple' | 'text', choices: ['Label'] or [{ label, value, description }], other: true or { label, placeholder } (a free-text Other answer), placeholder (text), multiline: false (a one-line text answer: a name, an email) }]. A required question blocks Next with an error until answered. Exposes answers ({ [name]: value, multiple as an array, Other as its text }), currentIndex, currentItem and isComplete; onStepChanged on every move, onSubmit with the answers (run the save query there). After submit it shows completeTitle and completeText. Actions reset() and goTo(index or name). defaultAnswers restores saved answers. Height: grows with the question (about 440px for four choices, 160px plus 58px per choice)

Radar (spider) chart comparing scores across categories: data [{ skill: 'Speed', alex: 86, jordan: 65 }], categoryField 'skill' (one spoke per row), yFields 'alex,jordan' (one filled polygon each); fillOpacity, gridShape polygon/circle, dots, legend, maxValue (blank = auto). Best square, 240-320 px; clicking sets clickedDataPoint and fires onClick.

Radial bar chart. Mode 'progress': one value against maxValue as a ring with a large centre figure (centerValue, blank = the value) and centerLabel. Mode 'categories': concentric bars from data [{ channel: 'Direct', visitors: 275 }] with categoryField and valueField, a row's fill or color wins. startAngle/endAngle in degrees (90/-270 full ring, 180/0 semicircle gauge); thickness in px. Ring 160-240 px square, gauge about twice as wide as tall.
Radio group. A label adds 22px above and help text 24px below

Rating: a row of 1 to 10 icons (star, heart or circle) with optional half steps and read-only mode; keyboard accessible. Exposes value (number, 0 for none). Height: 24px for the default size (32px for lg), plus 22px with a label

List of records as two-line rows, for a recent-orders, people, tickets or activity panel beside a chart or a table: an avatar (avatarField: an image URL, else the initials of that field's text, else of the title), the title (titleField), a meta line under it (metaFields, a comma list of field specs joined with ' · ': 'city', 'total|currency', 'due|date:Due {}' (value in a label), 'seats:Seats' (label first); formats number, currency, percent, compact, date, datetime), a progress bar under the meta line (progressField: a percentage 0 to 100, as 42 or '42%'; onboarding, a project's completion), a status chip on the right (statusField, toned by its words: Paid green, Pending amber, Overdue red, Open blue) and a trailing value (valueField in valueFormat: currency in currency, date, number, ...). density compact, default or comfortable; showDividers; listStyle 'card' (bordered panel) or 'plain'; avatarShape circle or rounded. A click selects the row (selectedItem, selectedItemId, selectedItemIndex; onItemClicked). Draws 100 rows and a Show more button. Height: grows with its rows (about 60px a row at default density)

Scatter or bubble chart relating two measures: data [{ account: 'Globex', spend: 30, revenue: 95, seats: 120, segment: 'Enterprise' }], xField 'spend', yField 'revenue', optional sizeField (bubbles), groupField (one colour and legend entry per value), nameField (tooltip title), xLabel/yLabel axis titles, referenceX/referenceY dashed quadrant lines, x and y formats. Height 260-360 px; clicking a point sets clickedDataPoint to its row and fires onClick.

Resource schedule: resources down the side (rooms, desks, people on shift or on call, vehicles, equipment) and time across, with bookings drawn as blocks. scale 'hours' shows one day (date, empty for today) from dayStart to dayEnd (hours, 0 to 24) with empty slots of slotMinutes: a one-day room or resource board is scale 'hours' (days is not read; scale 'days' with days 1 draws the same hours). scale 'days' is the multi-day overview: `days` days from date, a column a day (a week of shifts, an on-call rota), each booking filling its day. resources: ['Atlas', 'Cove'] or [{ id, name, caption, avatar }] (empty: the distinct values of the bookings' resourceField). bookings: rows read through startField and endField (an ISO date-time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm', 'HH:mm' for a time on the shown day, or 'YYYY-MM-DD' for a whole day; no end lasts an hour), resourceField (a resource's id or name), titleField, subtitleField (a second line: the host, the person) and statusField (toned by its words: Confirmed green, Tentative or Pending amber, Cancelled red, Booked blue; or a tone name success | warning | danger | info | neutral. There are no other colours: a colour word such as purple shows the accent). Overlapping bookings of one resource stack in lanes. A now-line marks the current time on today (showNowLine). A click on a booking exposes selectedBooking (its row) and selectedBookingId and fires onBookingClicked; a click on an empty slot exposes selectedSlot { resourceId, resource, start and end (ISO date-times: prefill a date-time field from start), date ('YYYY-MM-DD'), startTime and endTime ('HH:mm' text, not a date), label } and fires onSlotClicked (open a booking form from it). hourFormat 12h or 24h; resourceTitle heads the resource column. A long hour range or short slots scroll sideways inside the widget rather than squeeze (each slot at least 28px, the shortest booking 40px), the resource column staying put; a short booking's full title is in its tooltip. Height: grows with its rows (40px header plus rowHeight, default 56, per resource; more where bookings overlap)
Select. Height: 64px with a label (label above the control), 36px without; add 24px for help text
Separator
Loading placeholder
Slider, single value or range. Height: 64px with a label (label above the control), 36px without; add 24px for help text

Tiny line or area trend for KPI cards, no axes or grid: data [12, 18, 15, 22] or [{ x: 'Mon', y: 12 }]; type line/area, curve, end dot, colorByTrend (last vs first value, positiveColor/negativeColor styles; lowerIsBetter flips it), optional min/max band. Height 24-64 px (40 typical), placed under a Stat; exposes trend ('up' | 'down' | 'flat') and lastValue.

Loading spinner: variant ('ring', 'dots'), size ('sm' 16px, 'default' 24px, 'lg' 32px, or px), optional label with labelPosition ('right' beside, 'bottom' below); spinnerColor style (default: the primary). Height: 24px with the label beside (32px for lg), 52px with it below

Dashboard figure, from a single number to a full KPI card: label, value (a number groups its digits; valueFormat currency in currency, percent or compact formats it), change badge (change, trend) with a context line (changeLabel, e.g. 'vs last month'), footnote; optional icon (any lucide name, iconPosition right, left or top, iconStyle square, circle or none), trendData for a small trend line under the figure (numbers or [{ x, y }]), progress (0 to 100) with progressLabel for a target bar, and size sm, default or lg. Each part shows only when set. Styles valueFontFamily ('serif', 'display', 'mono', ...), labelTextTransform ('uppercase') and labelLetterSpacing ('0.1em') set the figure's typeface and a small-caps label

Stepper (native Steps names): steps [{ id, name, description?, visible?, disabled?, tooltip? }]; currentStep is the current step's id; numbered circles (variant 'dots' for small dots), check marks on completed steps, connecting lines; orientation 'horizontal' or 'vertical'. stepsSelectable lets users click a step (onSelect; exposed currentStepId, currentStepIndex). Actions setStep(id), nextStep, previousStep, resetSteps, setStepVisible(id, visible), setStepDisable(id, disabled). Height: 60px horizontal (78px with descriptions); vertical about 66px per step

Strip of 3 to 6 headline figures in one row with hairline separators (no card per figure), to sit above or beside a table or a chart: items [{ label, value, format, delta, deltaFormat, tone, lowerIsBetter, caption }] (at most 6 shown). value formats in the item's format, else valueFormat (auto: currency for money labels such as Revenue or Average order, a grouped number otherwise; number, currency in currency, percent, compact, date). delta: a number is signed and shown in deltaFormat (percent: 12.5 shows +12.5%; number; currency), text shows as written ('+3 this week'); its colour is the item's tone (positive, negative, neutral), else its sign (up green, down red; lowerIsBetter flips it for churn, refunds, wait times). caption is a small line under the figure ('vs last month'). appearance 'panel' (one bordered panel) or 'plain'; size sm, default or lg; align left or center. Narrow widths wrap figures into rows. Height: about 90px (sm 70px, lg 110px) a row, plus 18px with captions
Switch with label

Superseded for new builds: use Table with styles.tableLook "shadcn" (ToolJet's own Table drawn in the look, with every Table feature and convention). Kept so existing apps keep working. Data table: typed columns (text, number, currency, date, badge, tags, boolean, link, image, avatar, progress, buttons), search, sort, filters, pagination (client or server side), single or bulk selection, inline editing with save/discard, CSV export, column chooser. Native Table conventions
Tabs: a container with one canvas per tab (parent the tab content with slot_name tab-<id>). Variants: pills (the default), underline, or steps (a wizard with Back/Next/Finish buttons)

Read-only tag chips: tags is an array or a comma-separated string; tagColors maps a value to a colour ({ Paid: '#16a34a' }: tinted chip, light background and strong text of that hue); variant ('soft', 'outline', 'solid'), size ('sm', 'default', 'lg'), overflow ('wrap', or 'single' for one line with +N), pill. Clicking a tag sets lastClickedTag and fires onTagClicked. Height: 24px per line

Tags input: free-form tags typed in the field (Enter or comma adds, Backspace removes the last, x removes one), with optional suggestions, maxTags, duplicate check and a per-tag pattern. Exposes values (array of text). Height: 64px with a label, 36px without (one row; grows with dynamic height)

Paragraph, lead, muted or small text. Typeface styles: fontFamily ('theme', 'sans', 'serif', 'display' or 'mono'), fontWeight, fontSize (px), letterSpacing (px or em) and textTransform (a small uppercase eyebrow: tone small, textTransform 'uppercase', letterSpacing '0.12em')
Multi-line input with label. A label adds 22px above and help text 24px below

Vertical timeline / activity feed: items [{ title, description, time, status or color, icon? }] (status words such as done, active, pending, failed take theme colours; statusColors maps your own); marker ('dot' or 'icon' with lucide names); density ('comfortable', 'compact'); newestFirst; timePosition ('right', 'top'); dateFormat for ISO times. Clicking an item sets lastClickedItem and fires onItemClicked. Height: about 66px per item with a description (44px without), 50px compact

Time picker: a field opening hour, minute and AM/PM columns, or (pickerStyle list) one list of times; both offer a time every minuteStep minutes from midnight (with 45: 09:00, 09:45, 10:30). Exposes value as 'HH:mm' in 24-hour time ('' when empty) and formattedValue as shown ('2:30 PM' or '14:30'); defaultValue, minTime and maxTime take '14:30' or '2:30 PM'. Height: 64px with a label (label above the control), 36px without; add 24px for help text or a validation message
